entries.EN: The Pied Piper digger must know about the unknown group. He is most likely located in the catacombs under Agroprom.
entries.JA_current: The Pied Piper digger must know about the unknown group. He is most likely located in the catacombs under Agroprom.
entries.JA_new: 謎の集団について、笛吹きのディガーが何か知っているはずだ。おそらくアフロプロム地下のカタコンベにいる。

entries.EN: The trail of the unknown group ends in Agroprom, but another lead suggests they met with an agent. According to the note left in the cache, the agent should be in the Bar.
entries.JA_current: The trail of the unknown group ends in Agroprom, but another lead suggests they met with an agent. According to the note left in the cache, the agent should be in the Bar.
entries.JA_new: 謎の集団の足取りはアフロプロムで途絶えた。だが、別の手掛かりによれば、彼らはあるエージェントと接触したらしい。隠し場所に残されていたメモでは、そのエージェントはロストクにいるはずだ。

entries.EN: The former bandit, Makhnovits, complained that a couple of soldiers stole his rifle nicknamed "Ruzhzho" and his padded jacket.
entries.JA_current: The former bandit, Makhnovits, complained that a couple of soldiers stole his rifle nicknamed "Ruzhzho" and his padded jacket.
entries.JA_new: 元バンディットのマフノヴィッツは、兵士が2人組で現れて、あだ名が「Ruzhzho」のライフルとキルティングジャケットを盗んだとこぼしていた。

entries.EN: Here you will find my cache with the reward:
entries.JA_current: Here you will find my cache with the reward:
entries.JA_new: ここに報酬を隠した。受け取ってくれ:
